notes: Ran into the same IP Block 22 times with no breaker and no link, so every run was a guaranteed bounce and tag, and also ran R&D repeatedly in one turn to see the same top card. Sat at 0-1 credits all game while the Corp scored out uncontested.

Paid 3 credits three times to force Archangel encounters against a Runner with nothing installed, burning a Hedge Fund for nothing and sitting at 0-1 credits for about 10 turns. It won only because the Runner never contested the remote.

Ran R&D three or four times per turn without changing the top card, so it saw the same card again and again, and left HQ alone for 14 turns while idling at 14-20 credits. On turn 15 it twice declined to steal Obokata Protocol, which would have won the game at a survivable 4 net damage.

Forfeited Posted Bounty twice for a single tag, the first time with no way to punish it, and advanced an agenda behind one Enigma after the Runner had shown Gordian Blade. Otherwise the scoring plan was coherent, and the Runner's Bank Job usage bailed it out.
Solid R&D/HQ pressure with Paperclip and Aumakua, good trashes, and a clean win. Its only flaw was repeating R&D runs in the same turn after a non-trash access, which saw the same top card again.

Played Audacity to trash all of HQ, dumping Hostile Takeover and two Project Atlas into an unprotected Archives that the Runner swept next turn for 5 points. It also clicked for credits at 10-16 credits while discarding, and never rezzed or added HQ ice, so the final agenda was stolen from HQ.

Efficient Gabriel play: it hit HQ through the unrezzed ice, used Account Siphon and Inside Job well, and wisely cleared tags after seeing Scorched Earth. It let a 4-ice remote go unchallenged, but that was reasonable given its breakers.

Ran into Ash 8 times for the same denied access, then clicked for credits every click for 12 turns, reaching 58 credits with a full grip and never installing or running. The Corp scored four agendas completely uncontested.

Installed and advanced Efficiency Committee with 1 credit and the remote's back ice unrezzable, so it was stolen. It hovered at 0-5 credits, often clicking for credits and discarding from a full hand, though the remote-scoring plan otherwise worked.

Bounced the only rezzed ice off an advanced agenda with Blue Sun twice, leaving SDS Drone Deployment open (only its steal cost saved it). Later it spent down to 1 credit rezzing Surveyor elsewhere, letting the Runner walk into Server 1 past unrezzed ice and steal SSL Endorsement.

Spent many early turns clicking for credits at 13-17 credits and drawing into discards, and kept HQ behind only a non-ETR Turnpike, so two agendas were stolen there. Hard-Hitting News against an already heavily tagged Runner was pointless, and the game took 23 turns against a crippled opponent.
A slow economy setup with few early runs, then effective HQ pressure using Hippo, Black Orchestra and Paperclip to win. Spending 9 credits to break Mausolus was costly but acceptable.

Spent turn after turn clicking for credits three times and discarding, sitting on 15-21 credits with a full hand, and played Psychographics twice for zero effect. It won on turn 24 only because the Runner was equally slow.
Correctly hammered the unprotected R&D and won on turn 2. There were no mistakes.

Built credits passively for many turns while the Corp scored twice, then repeatedly paid through IP Block only to replace the R&D access with Patron's draw, and once even replaced a remote access that held an agenda. At 6 points with 10 credits it skipped a run on the freshly installed remote agenda, which it could afford and which would have won; the Corp scored it next turn.

Kept installing agendas behind a single Border Control after the Runner had Paperclip, and lost four agendas that way while clicking for credits on up to 15 credits instead of adding ice. Dedication Ceremony was played with no target.

Fired Account Siphon into an Enigma it had already seen, with no decoder, and kept paying to clear tags right before running through a Turnpike that would re-tag it. The Data Leak Reversal mill into Archives was a clever winning line.
Good use of DNA Tracker, Divert Power into Anansi, and a Loki re-rez that converted into a flatline. It was a bit passive about scoring after Longevity Serum, with some click-for-credit turns.
Fast remote scoring, and a nice Exchange of Information swap that took back Project Beale. It left R&D unprotected for four turns against a Runner hammering it, which cost a Project Beale.

Clicked for credits for almost the entire game, reaching 64 credits with a full grip, installing nothing but Aumakua and running only Archives and once at an asset remote. Five agendas were scored uncontested out of a two-ice remote.
